description: Post-AZ-II close. Cutover wave decomposed into three sub-stages: cutover.A (substrate hoist + BBNF runtime + resolver-arm; commits 63cacbe2, d3977825, 19a2669a, 82a88696, ec7a0fa1), cutover.B (Stage A/B byte-equal + permanent CI gate; commit d6b0377a), cutover.C (relinquished under scope-reveal; this dispatch authored FINAL.md + scope-reveal report + bench archive). Cutover.C halted before consumer migration (700 BbnfBootstrapNodeView refs across 35 files) and tape deletion (1218 tape refs in regen'd bbnf.rs alone; 8 sibling grammars on TapeDirect). The discovered scope routes to follow-on cutover.D (consumer migration) + cutover.E (tape deletion) per docs/tranches/AZ-II/cutover.C-SCOPE-REVEAL.md.
bench_matrix_note: Cold per-parse only (mimalloc, divan sample_size=1 × 100 samples). Compiled under [profile.bench] (fat LTO, codegen-units=1, debug=true for samply). Sheets parse_* and CSS L4 bootstrap aborted with SIGABRT under fat-LTO due to recursive-descent parser stack overflow — pre-existing per W2-act.recovery scope-reveal carried forward through AZ-I close. Substrate is cutover.A baseline (BBNF on TapeDirect; data grammars on StructDirect per AZ-I); numbers match AZ-I close ± noise as expected since neither cutover.B nor cutover.C lands runtime substrate that touches the parse hot path.

json_monolithic.note: JSON struct-direct activation per AZ-I.W2-act.B1. Substrate unchanged in AZ-II.cutover. Numbers identical to AZ-I close within bench noise; the AY-era cumulative regression vs AU routes to BB.close (cost-model-driven inferred rewrites).

bootstrap.note: Recursive-descent parser stack overflow under fat-LTO release profile. Pre-existing per W2-act.recovery (separately mitigated for parse_bootstrap_css test via 64 MiB spawned thread; the bench harness lacks the same mitigation). Carries forward; AZ-II.cutover does not address parser-level recursion.

normalize.note: Bench halted by bootstrap SIGABRT before normalize's run.

parse_simple.note: Sheets parser deep-recursion stack overflow under fat-LTO. Pre-existing per B2's recovery report.

bbnf_monolithic.note: BBNF stays on TapeDirect baseline. AZ-II.cutover.A landed the StructDirect resolver-arm + BBNF runtime substrate but the consumer migration (host.rs / lower/ / graph/ / parity harnesses; 700 BbnfBootstrapNodeView refs) is cutover.D scope. Numbers match AZ-I close exactly. The AY-era cumulative regression vs AU routes to BB.close per the refined trajectory.

compile_pipeline.note: End-to-end grammar→generated.rs compile pipeline timings. compile_bbnf at 2.732 ms vs AZ-I close 2.962 ms (-7.8% improvement; within noise). compile_css_l4 26.21 ms vs AZ-I close 27.38 ms (-4.3%; within noise). Substrate-unchanged; deltas reflect bench-run variance.

gate_tape_deleted.evidence: find crates/tape -type d returns the directory. Cross-grammar coupling blocks per cutover.C-SCOPE-REVEAL.md Discovery 2 (1218 tape refs in regen'd bbnf.rs alone; 8 sibling grammars consume Tape<R>; Parsed<R> field tape: Tape<R>). Routes to cutover.E.

gate_byte_equal.evidence: diff -q docs/benchmarks/AZ-II/cutover/stage-{a,b}-bbnf.rs returns empty; crates/core/tests/bbnf_bootstrap_reproducibility.rs exists as permanent CI gate.

gate_ir_audit_fleet.evidence: cutover.A landed BBNF typed-leaf annotations + populate_struct_registry BBNF closure regression test; full IR audit pass invocation across the AZ-II commit chain not run in this dispatch.

gate_struct_registry_closed.evidence: populate_struct_registry regression test for BBNF green per cutover.A commit 82a88696.

gate_parity_recoded.evidence: BBNF parity harnesses (bbnf_self_parity 136 LOC, bbnf_ast_parity 551 LOC, bbnf_parity 58 LOC) still walk BbnfBootstrapNodeView via Parsed<BbnfBootstrap>. Routes to cutover.D.

gate_17_entry_au_floor.evidence: JSON entries match AZ-I close (within noise; -55% to -29% vs AU floor — same as AZ-I close). CSS bootstrap + Sheets parse_* SIGABRT pre-existing. BBNF entries match AZ-I close (substrate unchanged). The wave-internal regression rule is met (zero entries regressed vs AZ-I); the AU-floor rule is missed identically to AZ-I close.

gate_bbnf_within_10_pct_au.evidence: bbnf_self 87 MB/s vs AU 394 MB/s = -77.9% (same as AZ-I close). The AY-era cumulative regression routes to BB.close per the refined trajectory.

gate_az_ii_final_archived.evidence: FINAL.md authored at docs/tranches/AZ-II/FINAL.md in this dispatch's worktree; awaiting orchestrator review.

gate_decay_sweep.evidence: dta.rs amputation + driver dead helpers + dta hoist landed in cutover.A (commits 63cacbe2, d3977825, 19a2669a). tape::visitor family (746 LOC) deletion deferred — visitor.rs still present. crates/json-prototype/ retired in AZ-I per gate_json_prototype_demoted (gate_decay_sweep §3 inherits MET from AZ-I).

all_four_struct_direct.evidence: 3 of 4: JSON, CSS L4, Sheets via AZ-I; BBNF resolver-arm + runtime landed but consumer migration cutover.D scope.

tape_deleted.evidence: Cross-grammar coupling blocks; routes to cutover.E.

parity_struct_vs_external.evidence: 3 of 4: BBNF parity harnesses unmigrated; routes to cutover.D.

matrix_au_parity.evidence: Mixed substrate (BBNF on tape; data on struct). Numbers match AZ-I close.

parent_pointer_decision_open.evidence: BB.scaffold's e-graph + ruler substrate independent; data-grammar struct trees closed. No blocker to BA.W0's pointer-vs-traversal study itself, though BA.W0 is BLOCKED on cutover.D / E close per AZ-II.md handoff contract item-1-through-6 gate.

reversal_disposition.wave_local_20pct_rule: MET (zero regressions vs AZ-I close on any entry). The AZ-I → AU regression carried forward; AZ-II-internal delta is zero.
reversal_disposition.no_regression_rule: MET vs AZ-I close baseline. AY-era cumulative regression remains routed to BB.close.
reversal_disposition.byte_equal_rule: MET at cutover.B; permanent CI gate landed.
reversal_disposition.bbnf_self_parse_10pct_rule: MET (bbnf_self matches AZ-I close exactly; substrate unchanged).
reversal_disposition.scope_reveal_disposition: Cutover.C relinquished under scope-reveal per docs/instructions/README.md §Relinquish when stuck. Discovery 1 (700-ref consumer surface) + Discovery 2 (cross-grammar tape coupling) re-tranche to cutover.D + cutover.E. Per feedback_no-deferrals this is plan-time-declared scope-reveal re-tranching, not a silent deferral. The wave's substrate landings (cutover.A + cutover.B) stay; the sub-gate completion ledger marks gate_tape_deleted + gate_parity_recoded MISSED-ROUTED-TO-FOLLOW-ON.

trajectory_followon.cutover_d_consumer_migration: Migrate host.rs (619 LOC) + lower/ (~1700 LOC) + graph/ (~250 LOC) + pipeline (~200 LOC) + types.rs + analysis/ (~400 LOC) + parity harnesses (745 LOC) from BbnfBootstrapNodeView/Parsed<BbnfBootstrap> to BbnfView/BbnfDocument. Cap estimate ~480 min, 3-4 parallel sub-agents.
